findings.title: Metapath/DWPC vs mechanistic on external repoDB (decision gate)
findings.detail: On 559 Hetionet-mappable repoDB pairs: best single metapath 0.532 (unsupervised), mechanistic 0.746, metapath CV-LR 0.594 (lift -0.1521), mech+metapath ensemble 0.729 (lift -0.0164); negative control 0.511. DO NOT integrate — metapath does not clearly beat the mechanistic score on the external benchmark.
findings.capa: Integrate the metapath signal only on a positive, reproducible external lift; otherwise keep the mechanistic score (simpler) and revisit features.
